The '''Sword Man '''is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']]''.''

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:SwordManL.gif|80px]]

Sword Men first appear in [[Death Valley|Act 2-2]]. They are palette swaps of the [[Biker]] enemy and do the same thing, only with a sword instead of a baseball bat. They only deal 1 point of damage on contact, and are easily defeated in one hit by any attack.
